question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the following sentence.**

The health-care system is in transition __at those moment.__
solution:
The correct answer is** 'at the moment'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to substitute the underlined words in the sentence is:* "at the moment."*
